task: What is the support escalation deadline?
annotation: The support-policy document alone contains the requested deadline. Office procedures cannot establish it.

documents.text: The support escalation deadline is four hours after a case is opened. Escalate to the duty lead if the assigned responder has not resolved the case. Keep the original case reference in the escalation message.
Lunch is served from noon until 14:00. Vegetarian dishes are marked with a green card. The kitchen publishes its menu every Monday and clears trays at the end of service.
Water the lobby planters twice a week. Check the soil before watering and return the watering can to the supply closet. Replacement pots are stored beside the maintenance desk.
Visitors park in the east lot. The bicycle entrance is on the south side of the building. Staff may request a permit from reception and should display it on the dashboard.
